title: Can Large Language Models Identify Implicit Suicidal Ideation? An Empirical Evaluation
reasoning: The paper focuses on the clinical and psychological identification of suicidal ideation in LLM responses using frameworks like the Death/Suicide Implicit Association Test (D/S-IAT). While it assesses 'ethical safety' in a clinical context to ensure models do not encourage self-harm, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, spiritual traditions, or philosophical ethical/moral systems.
